title: CreateAeroCozy
description: Low Cortisol Modpack: For Fun & Building Crazy Machines!
body:
### Welcome to a world built for relaxation.

Create Aerocozy is a carefully curated modpack designed for the casual player who wants to experience the magic of automation and flight without losing the soul of vanilla Minecraft. We believe that building a factory or piloting a dirigible shouldn't feel like a second job—it should feel like a peaceful hobby.

By focusing exclusively on the Create and Create: Aeronautics ecosystems, we've stripped away the chaos of complex tech mods and harsh survival mechanics. Instead, you'll find a gentle, intuitive progression that lets you focus on what matters: creativity, aesthetics, and the joy of flight.

Whether you are crafting your first kinetic engine or designing a custom airship to explore the horizon, every step is designed to feel natural, familiar, and deeply satisfying.


### for those looking for
- 🍃 True Vanilla Feel: No overwhelming skill trees or confusing recipes. The gameplay flows naturally, respecting the rhythm of the original game while adding a layer of mechanical wonder.
- ⚙️ Elegant Automation: Dive into the world of Create with a focus on visual beauty and logical simplicity. Build stunning contraptions that look as good as they work.
- ☁️ Soar with Ease: Take to the skies with Create: Aeronautics. Design and pilot your own airships, blimps, and flying machines in a safe, stress-free environment.
- 🧘 Casual Friendly: Perfect for short play sessions or long creative marathons. There is no pressure to optimize—just build and play.

_This is my first modpack project, so I apologize for any problems or conflicts encountered. Have a good gaming experience_
